value.rationale: A natural and previously uncharacterized dependence structure for the already-studied thresholded tree sizes: nested counts can have negative covariance; a unique exact sign threshold occurs at logarithmic/n separation with a universal limit curve. This also yields microscopic exponential correlation and distinct-threshold joint independence, giving meaningful multiscale structure rather than an arbitrary cutoff.
